revealed_content.statement: The raw event counts independently reproduce the claimed relative risk of 1.5 with a 95% confidence interval that excludes 1.
revealed_content.plan: Calculated the raw Relative Risk (RR) using the formula (events_treat/tot_treat)/(events_ctrl/tot_ctrl). Computed the 95% Confidence Interval using the log-normal method: exp(ln(RR) ± 1.96*sqrt(1/events_treat + 1/events_ctrl)). Compared the calculated RR and CI to the published baseline_rr of 1.5.
